name: Doutor Coffee Hongo-Sanchome Higashi
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 本郷三丁目東店
description: A budget Doutor branch a minute from Hongo-sanchome station that a power/Wi-Fi database lists as having usable outlets, making it a practical quick-work stop.

name: Doutor Coffee Hongo-Sanchome
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 本郷三丁目店
description: A second Doutor almost next door to the Higashi branch by Hongo-sanchome, also listed with power outlets and carrier Wi-Fi for short laptop sessions.

name: Starbucks Hongo Todai-mae
nameJa: スターバックス コーヒー 本郷東大前店
address: 4-1-4 Hongo, Design Place Alpha 1F, Bunkyo-ku, Tokyo
description: A roughly fifty-seat Starbucks near Hongo-sanchome with free Wi-Fi, but its former counter outlets have been switched off, so plan to work on battery.

name: Starbucks University of Tokyo Faculty of Engineering
nameJa: スターバックス コーヒー 東京大学工学部店
address: 7-3-1 Hongo, UTokyo Engineering Bldg 11, Bunkyo-ku, Tokyo
description: A campus Starbucks inside the University of Tokyo engineering building that is open to the public and offers free Wi-Fi plus a handful of usable power seats.

name: Doutor Coffee UTokyo Yasuda Auditorium
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 東京大学安田講堂前店
description: A Doutor on the University of Tokyo campus near Yasuda Auditorium with carrier Wi-Fi but no customer outlets according to the outlet database.

name: Starbucks Korakuen LaQua
nameJa: スターバックス コーヒー 後楽園ラクーア店
description: A Starbucks in the LaQua complex at Tokyo Dome City with confirmed free Wi-Fi, though outlet availability is undocumented so assume none.

name: Cafe Veloce Kasuga Station Front
nameJa: カフェ・ベローチェ 春日駅前店
description: A cheap Veloce right in front of Kasuga station with free Wi-Fi but no power outlets per the outlet database, best for short visits.

name: Doutor Coffee Edogawabashi Shin-Mejiro-dori
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 江戸川橋新目白通り店
description: A Doutor near Edogawabashi on Shin-Mejiro-dori flagged as having power seats plus carrier Wi-Fi, a solid budget work spot in western Bunkyo.

name: Coffeekan Nezu Station Front
nameJa: 珈琲館 根津駅前店
description: A classic-style Coffeekan directly outside Nezu station offering SoftBank-spot Wi-Fi but no listed power outlets, fine for a laptop on battery.

name: Starbucks Myogadani
nameJa: スターバックス コーヒー 茗荷谷店
address: 1-4-1 Otsuka, Chuo University Myogadani Campus, Bunkyo-ku, Tokyo
description: A Starbucks at the Chuo University Myogadani campus, three minutes from the station, with roughly sixty seats and standard free Wi-Fi but no outlet seats.
